diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.ng in aws_autoscaling_group.ng is redundant: the dependency is already established transitively through aws_launch_template.ng (which references aws_iam_instance_profile.ng.0.arn), which in turn depends on aws_iam_role.ng.

The explicit depends_on on aws_launch_template.ng in aws_autoscaling_group.ng is redundant: aws_autoscaling_group.ng already references aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and .latest_version in its mixed_instances_policy launch_template_specification, which establishes the dependency implicitly.

The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.ng in aws_eks_node_group.ng is redundant: the node group already references aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn via its node_role_arn attribute, which establishes the dependency implicitly.

The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.fargate in aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate is redundant: the profile already references aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn via its pod_execution_role_arn attribute, which establishes the dependency implicitly.
